text: The Co-Chair of the Toronto Music Advisory Committee (TMAC) will lead a discussion with Committee Members on identifying the steps for having TMAC organize and host a series of music-industry stakeholder forums. Members will be asked to suggest topics for the forums, to target the needs of particular elements of the sector and/or issues raised in the Toronto Music Strategy, with a goal of identifying concerns and opportunities for the City to positively impact the music community.
The Toronto Music Advisory Committee received the item for information.
